questions.question: A sum of Rs.8,400 becomes Rs.10,164 in 2 years at a certain rate percentage p.a., interest compounded yearly. What will be the simple interest on the same sum for 4(3)/(5) years at the same rate?
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Principal = Rs. 8,400

Amount = Rs. 10,164

Time = 2 years

Time for SI = 4(3)/(5) years = 23/5 years

__**Formula used:**__

Amount(A) = P × (1 + r/100)t

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

__**Calculation:**__

∵ Amount(A) = P × (1 + r/100)t 

⇒ 10,164 = 8400 × (1 + r/100)².

⇒ (1 + r/100)2 = 10,164/8,400

⇒ (1 + r/100)2 = 121/100

⇒ 1 + r/100 = 11/10

⇒ 100 + r = 110

⇒ r = 10

Rate of interest = 10%

SI = (8400 × 10 × 23)/5 × 100

⇒ Rs. 3,864

__**Alternative Method to find r%:**__

When time is 2 years;

Amount / Principal = √(10,164/8400) = 11/10

∴ Rate % = [(11 - 10)/10] × 100

⇒ 10%

Average score of 84 students = 57

Ratio of boy and Girl = 10 ∶ 11

Average score of boys = (80/100) × Average score of girls

Average on 'n' numbers = (Sum of 'n' numbers)/n

sum of 'n' numbers = (Average on 'n' numbers) × n

= 4788

Let the Number of boys and girls = 10x and 11x

∵ Total marks scored by 40 boys + Total marks scored by 44 girls = Total marks scored by 84 students

∴ 160y + 220y = 4788

⇒ 380y = 4788

⇒ y = 4788/380

⇒ y = 12.6

Average score of 44 girls = 5y

= 5 × 12.6

= 63

questions.question: Which of the following is divisible by 99?
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

To check the divisibility of a number by 99, we need to check if that number is divisible by 9 and 11.

__**Divisibility by 9:**__

If the sum of the digits of the given number is divisible by 9, then that number is divisible by 9.

Eg. 756 is divisible by 9 because the sum of digits of 756 = 7 + 5 + 6 = 18 is divisible by 9.

__**Divisibility by 11**__:

If the difference between "Sum of digits at the even place" and "Sum of digits at odd place" is divisible by 11 or it is 0, then the whole number is divisible by 11.

Such as, 9174.

(9 + 7) - (4 + 1) = 16 - 5 = 11 is divisible by 11. So, 9174 is also divisible by 11.

__**Calculation:**__

By checking through options,

Number 2767149 is divisible by both 9 and 11.

Sum of digits of 2767149 

= 2 + 7 + 6 + 7 + 1 + 4 + 9 = 36 which is divisible by 9.

∴ 2767149 is divisible by 9.

(Sum of digits at even place) - (Sum of digits at odd place) = (7 + 7 + 4) - (2 + 6 + 1 + 9)

= 18 - 18

= 0

∴ 2767149 is also divisible by 11.

∵ 2767149 is divisible by both 9 and 11.

∴ 2767149 is divisible by 99.

questions.question: A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of his goods at 25% above the cost price. He sells 60% of the goods at the marked price and the rest at a discount of 40%. What is his gain/loss percentage?
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Marked up % = 25%

% of goods sold at MP = 60%

Discount on 40% goods = 40%

__**Concept:**__

Since, this question only deals in %, so we can consider any number as the number of goods as per our convenience. Therefore consider the number of goods to be 10 and CP as 100a.

__**Formula used:**__

Profit% = (Profit × 100)/CP

__**Calculation:**__

Let, the number of goods = 10

CP of each goods = 100a 

∴ CP of all 10 goods = 10 × 100a 

= 1000a

∵ MP price = 25% of 100a

= 25a

∴ MP = 100a + 25a

= 125a

60% Goods are sold at marked price.

∴ SP of 6 goods = 125a × 6

= 750a

There is a discount of 40% on 40% goods.

Discount amount = 40% of 125a

= (40/100) × 125a

= 50a

∴ SP after discount = 125a - 50a

= 75a

∴ SP of 4 goods = 4 × 75a

= 300a

∴ Total SP of 10 goods = 750a + 300a

= 1050a

∵ The SP is greater than CP, so there is an overall profit.

Profit = SP - CP

= 1050a - 1000a

= 50a

∴ Profit% = (Profit × 100)/CP

= (50a × 100)/1000a

= 5%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let, CP = 100a, and MP = 125a

Let, total number of goods = 10

Now, 60% of 10 = 6 goods sold at rate of 125a

So, SP of 6 goods = 125a × 6 = 750a

Now, rest (10 - 6) = 4 goods are sold at = 125a × (100 - 40)/100 = 75a

So, the SP of 4 goods = 75a × 4 = 300a

Total income of the shopkeeper (SP) = 750a + 300a = 1050a

Total CP = 100a × 10 = 1000a

Now, profit = 1050a - 1000a = 50a

**∴ Profit percentage = 100 × 50a/1000a = 5%**

questions.question: An article is sold at a profit of 15%. If both the cost price and the selling price of the article are reduced by Rs.140 each, then the profit percentage becomes 19.2%. The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Initial profit% = 15%

Final profit% = 19.2%

Reduction in SP and CP = Rs. 140 each

__**Formula used:**__

Profit% = (Profit × 100)/CP

profit = SP - CP

__**Calculation:**__

Let the CP = 100a

∴ Profit on CP = 15% of 100a

= 15a

∴ SP = 115a

New CP = 100a - 140

New SP = 115a - 140

∴ New profit = SP - CP

= 115a - 140 - (100a - 140)

= 115a - 140 - 100a + 140

= 15a

∴ Profit% = (Profit × 100)/CP

⇒ 19.2 = (15a × 100)/(100a - 140)

⇒ 19.2 × (100a - 140) = 1500a 

⇒ 1920a - 2688 = 1500a

⇒ 1920a - 1500a = 2688

⇒ 420a = 2688

⇒ a = 2688/420

⇒ a = 6.4

∴ Original CP of the article = 100a 

= 100 × 6.4

= Rs. 640

Profit = SP - CP

= 231.3 - 225

= Rs. 6.3

∴ Profit% = (6.3 × 100)/225

questions.question: Train X running at 50 km/h leaves stations A at 11 a.m., and train Y running at 90 km/h on parallel tracks leaves station A at 3 p.m. on the same day and in the same direction. After what distance from station A will both the trains be together?
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Speed of train X = 50 km/h

Time of departure of train X = 11 am

Speed of train Y = 90 km/h

Time of departure of train Y = 3 pm 

__**Concept:**__

Use the relative speed concept. Since, train X has already travelled for 4 hrs when train Y leaves the station in the same direction. Therefore, train Y have to cover the distance travelled by train X with the relative speed with respect to train X to catch up with X.

__**Formula used:**__

Speed = Distance/Time

__**Calculation:**__

Distance traveled by train X in 4 hrs = 50 × 4

= 200 km

Relative speed of train Y w.r.t train X = 90 - 50

= 40 km/hr

∴ Time taken by Y to catch train X = Distance/Speed

= 200/40

= 5 hrs.

∴ Total distance after which the trains will meet = (Speed of train Y) × (Time taken to catch train X)

= 90 × 5

= 450 km

questions.question: What is the area (in cm²) of a circle circumscribing a triangle whose sides are 28 cm, 45 cm and 53 cm?
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Sides of triangle = 28 cm, 45 cm, 53 cm

__**Concept:**__

The circum-radius of a right angled triangle is equal to half of the hypotenuse.

__**Formula used:**__

Area of circle = pi r²

__**Calculation:**__

∵ (28)² + (45)² = (53)²

∴ The triangle formed by sides 28 cm, 45 cm and 53 cm is a right angled triangle.

∴ Circum-radius of the circle = 53/2 cm

∴ Area of the circle = pi × (53/2)² 

= pi × (2809/4)

= 702(1)/(4)pi cm²

questions.question: A person spends 60% of his monthly income. If his income increases by 60% and the expenditure increases by 90%, then what is the percentage increase/decrease in his monthly savings?
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Expenditure = 60% of Monthly salary

% increase in income = 60%

% increase in expenditure = 90%

__**Formula used:**__

% increase in savings = [(Final Savings - Initial savings)/Initial savings] × 100

__**Calculation**__:

Let the monthly salary = 100a

∴ Monthly expenditure = 60% of 100a

= 60a

Monthly Savings = Salary - Expenditure

= 100a - 60a

= 40a

∵ Increase in Monthly salary = 60% of 100a

= 60a

∴ New monthly salary = 100a + 60a

= 160a

% increase in expenditure = 90% of 60a

= (90/100) × 60a

= 54a

∴ New expenditure = 60a + 54a

= 114a

∴ New savings = 160a - 114a

= 46a

∴ % increase in Monthly savings = [(Final Savings - Initial savings)/Initial savings] × 100

= [(46a - 40a)/40a] × 100

= (6a/40a) × 100

= 15%
